From Detection to Corrective Action — At Scale

Beamup transforms how enterprises manage product availability autonomously

1. Continuous Signal Ingestion

Beamup continuously ingests execution signals across orders, shipments, inventory, suppliers, and operations - including system events and operational communications - to maintain a live view of what’s happening across the network.

2. Automated Issue Detection & Root Cause Identification

Beamup’s AI agents automatically detect execution issues and identify their root causes - such as lead-time mismatches, supplier delays, execution gaps, or inventory errors - across sites, SKUs, and workflows.

3. Automated Corrective Execution

Beamup executes corrective actions automatically - such as updating lead times, opening vendor tickets, triggering audits, or escalating to the right teams - resolving issues in seconds instead of hours.

The Scale of the Challenge

As supply chains grow more complex, manual execution breaks down. Teams can’t see patterns, prioritize what matters most, or act fast enough across thousands of sites, shipments, and SKUs — leading to recurring execution failures and avoidable cost.

We automate supply chain execution at scale.

Beamup uses purpose-built AI agents to detect issues, identify root causes, and execute corrective actions across stockouts, excess inventory, shrink, split shipments, and labor inefficiencies - without adding headcount.

Who We Serve

Retail

For large, multi-location retailers, execution failures - not demand - drive stockouts, excess inventory, shrink, and split shipments across the entire network.

Manufacturing

For complex manufacturing networks, execution gaps and material shortages drive production stoppages, inventory risk, and disrupted OTIF performance.

The Beamup Difference.

Traditional tools stop at visibility. Beamup automates execution.
Purpose-built AI agents continuously detect issues, identify root causes, and execute fixes at scale - without adding headcount.

Unified Data Model

Brings execution signals across stores, DCs, and in-transit operations into a single, actionable view.

Real-Time Intelligence

Continuously detects execution issues and risks as they emerge - not after impact.

Root Cause Clarity

Identifies why issues are happening across sites, SKUs, and workflows - not just where.

Autonomous Action

Executes fixes automatically or routes the right actions to the right teams at scale.
